connects_to.relationship: HV/LV switchgear and distribution transformers for Bloom Energy fuel-cell data-center power projects in North America (via LS ELECTRIC AMERICA Inc.)

contracts.signal: Supply contract disclosed 10-13-2026: 'Pennsylvania fuel-cell power-equipment supply project' - LS Electric supplies switchgear and distribution transformers to its subsidiary LS ELECTRIC AMERICA Inc., which won a fuel-cell-based power-equipment supply project for North American data centers ordered by Bloom Energy. Contract value KRW 185,257,183,992 = USD 138,458,284 at the Hana Bank rate of KRW 1,338.00 on the contract date, 3.73% of recent revenue (KRW 4,965,798,552,980, FY2025 consolidated); PO issued 2026-10-12; advance payment: none; billed per product delivery schedule. Term and amount may change.
